method: Verified community sentiment synthesized from registered links; sentiment is not mechanics. No copied posts, datasets, hidden values, or exact DPS claims.

weapons.name: Trident of the Covenant
verified_facts: Technique-oriented players frequently cite its reach and forgiving moveset
sourced displayed 30% critical chance is commonly discussed
weapons.sentiment: often preferred for safe general play
weapons.dissent: some players prefer faster handles or report matchup-dependent results
weapons.recommendation: offer as an optional Technique pivot, not a universal best weapon

weapons.name: Two Dragons Sword
verified_facts: community values its skill timing and Technique identity
weapons.sentiment: favored by players who enjoy deliberate parries
weapons.dissent: skill-dependent and less comfortable for players wanting simple reach
weapons.recommendation: recommend only when the player enjoys its timing loop

weapons.name: Etiquette
verified_facts: community recognizes its Technique-oriented identity and umbrella moveset
weapons.sentiment: niche but liked for style and defensive play
weapons.dissent: lower general enthusiasm than Trident or TDS
weapons.recommendation: present as a preference pick, not a damage claim

weapons.name: Azure Dragon Crescent Glaive
verified_facts: community discusses its reach and technique-skill utility
weapons.sentiment: popular with players seeking a flexible Technique option
weapons.dissent: moveset familiarity and availability shape opinions
weapons.recommendation: offer as an optional progression choice

weapons.name: Bone-Cutting Sawblade or Live Puppet Axe with Booster or Bramble handle
verified_facts: community builds these around reach, stagger pressure, and handle movesets
assembly outcomes depend on upgrades and player execution
weapons.sentiment: repeatedly recommended as practical Technique experimentation
weapons.dissent: weight, stamina, and preferred moveset cause disagreement
weapons.recommendation: test both assemblies before committing; do not infer exact scaling or DPS

weapons.name: Mjolnir + Police Baton or Live Puppet Axe combinations
verified_facts: community pairs Motivity heads and handles to seek blunt impact and charged-attack comfort
weapons.dissent: slow recovery and weight are frequent reservations
weapons.recommendation: suggest as a Motivity alternative, with stamina and Capacity checks

weapons.name: Proof of Humanity
verified_facts: sourced community discussions describe a 30% critical chance
availability and New Game Plus context affect recommendations
weapons.sentiment: highly praised in late-game and NG+ discussions
weapons.dissent: some players dislike its commitment, weight, or late availability
weapons.recommendation: present as a late-game/NG+ pivot and never as an early-route requirement

amulets.name: Assassin's Amulet
verified_facts: community discusses synergy with critical-focused weapons and attacks
amulets.sentiment: preferred when a build already pursues critical hits
amulets.dissent: value falls when critical opportunities are inconsistent
amulets.recommendation: describe synergy, not a guaranteed damage increase

amulets.name: Extreme Modification Amulet
verified_facts: community values filled Fable slots for its intended effect
amulets.dissent: slot opportunity cost and Fable availability matter
amulets.recommendation: recommend only when slots are reliably filled

amulets.name: Conquering Amulet
verified_facts: community associates it with perfect-guard damage windows
amulets.dissent: less attractive when guarding is inconsistent
amulets.recommendation: pair with the guard/perfect-guard practice loop

amulets.name: Patience Amulet
verified_facts: community associates it with stamina recovery
amulets.dissent: less needed with conservative stamina use
amulets.recommendation: offer for stamina comfort, not universal priority

amulets.name: Iron Wall Amulet
verified_facts: community associates it with defense
amulets.sentiment: preferred for learning and defensive play

amulets.name: Carrier's Amulet
verified_facts: community uses it primarily to reach equipment or weight thresholds
amulets.sentiment: utility pick rather than a default favorite
amulets.dissent: slot cost makes it unpopular once thresholds are met
amulets.recommendation: equip only when a concrete threshold requires it

amulets.name: Boss-Ergo amulets
verified_facts: community reports conflicts between spending boss Ergo and preserving rewards for special items
amulets.sentiment: recommendations vary by route and collection goals
amulets.dissent: completionists and immediate-power players prioritize differently
amulets.recommendation: surface the tradeoff before advising a purchase

boss_walls.name: Laxasia the Complete
verified_facts: community frequently identifies the encounter as a major late-game wall
boss_walls.sentiment: highly variable; guard timing and phase familiarity dominate reports
boss_walls.dissent: build and patch/NG+ context produce sharply different experiences
boss_walls.recommendation: give cautious practice advice, never promise a counter

boss_walls.name: Nameless Puppet
verified_facts: community frequently identifies it as a demanding optional final encounter
boss_walls.dissent: route, ending, build, and NG cycle change reports
boss_walls.recommendation: gate details behind spoilers and emphasize recoveries and stamina

boss_walls.name: King of Puppets / Romeo
verified_facts: community often reports a substantial two-phase difficulty spike
boss_walls.sentiment: variable; phase transition familiarity is repeatedly emphasized
boss_walls.dissent: players disagree on whether the first or second phase is the wall
boss_walls.recommendation: keep advice general unless spoilers are requested

boss_walls.name: Arlecchino
verified_facts: Overture community reports identify the fight as a potential wall
boss_walls.sentiment: clearly variable across builds and familiarity
boss_walls.dissent: limited independent coverage makes confidence lower
boss_walls.recommendation: flag Overture and avoid deterministic matchup claims

boss_walls.name: Tyrannical Predator
verified_facts: Overture community discussions describe a demanding encounter
boss_walls.recommendation: gate the name and use cautious practice guidance

calculator_research.name: No validated exact formula
verified_facts: No licensed, versioned, independently validated exact hidden AR/scaling/DPS formula was found
candidate repositories are research leads only
calculator_research.sentiment: community calculators are useful for hypotheses, not authoritative mechanics
calculator_research.dissent: different patches, rounding assumptions, saturation, and test setups produce conflicting outputs
calculator_research.recommendation: use only the deterministic displayed comparator; exclude defense, hidden scaling/saturation, animation DPS, status buildup, and Fable effects
